description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseDao class which provides data access methods for EmployeeLicense entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes CRUD operations, search functionalities, and licensing eligibility logic.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Employee License related database operations in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeLicense entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeLicense entity by employee number and license ID.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee license entries by employee number and list of license IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Searches for EmployeeLicense entities based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeLicense entities matching search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Retrieves licenses that are allowed for an employee based on specific filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed licenses for an employee.
